app.welcome: Welcome to the Jambiz Advent Calendar!
app.intro: Grab a cup of glögg and get comfy. Every morning in December a new door opens with a little Christmas game behind it. Beat it to unwrap a surprise from all of us at Jambiz.
app.footer: Made with 🎄, ❄️ and lots of glögg by the Jambiz team · Psst… try clicking the moon

juldle.title: Juldle
juldle.instruction: Guess the secret {{count}}-letter Christmas word – you have {{guesses}} tries.

emojiCarols.title: Emoji Carols
emojiCarols.instruction: Which Christmas classic is hiding in the emoji? Get {{pass}} of {{total}} right!
jeers: Oops – close, but no figgy pudding! 🍮
Whoops, slipped on the ice there! ⛸️
Not quite – now you know for next time! 📝
Nope – but the cocoa is still warm ☕
emojiCarols.winText: Santa is humming along – well done!
emojiCarols.failText: You need {{pass}} right. The questions get reshuffled – you've got this!

a.fact: The lyrics never actually mention Christmas – it's all about a sleigh ride in the snow!
The family flies to Paris without Kevin – who defends the house against two burglars.

wrong: Santa Claus Is Coming to Town
a.fact: Rudolph was created in 1939 for a department store's promotional booklet.
The green grump lives on a mountain – until his heart grows three sizes.
Wham! released it in 1984 – but it didn't hit number one in the UK until 2021.
Buddy's four main food groups: candy, candy canes, candy corn and syrup – ideally on spaghetti.

b.fact: It was written in Austria in 1818 and is now sung in hundreds of languages.
A handful of love stories in Christmassy London – plus a dancing prime minister.

b.answer: All I Want for Christmas Is You
b.fact: Mariah Carey released it in 1994 – and every December it climbs the charts again.
John McClane saves the office Christmas party at Nakatomi Plaza. Christmas movie? The debate rages on!
It was written on a scorching July day in Hollywood in 1945 – a daydream about cold weather.
Tom Hanks plays no fewer than six roles – including the conductor and Santa.

wrong: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
c.fact: Fa-la-la-la-la! The melody comes from an old Welsh carol.

wrong: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
c.fact: Add up every gift in the song and you get 364 – one for almost every day of the year!
Bing Crosby's version is the best-selling single of all time.

c.answer: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
c.fact: The carollers refuse to leave until they get some figgy pudding!
Gene Autry made it a hit in 1950 – a year after his "Rudolph" hit.
It started life in Germany as "O Tannenbaum".

d.fact: Charles Dickens wrote the story of the miser Scrooge in just six weeks in 1843.
Clark Griswold covers the house in 25,000 lights – so many the power plant has to switch to backup.
Three rules: no bright light, no water – and never feed them after midnight!
"Every time a bell rings, an angel gets his wings."
Jack Skellington from Halloween Town tries to take over Christmas – it goes… so-so.
Two women swap homes for Christmas – a Los Angeles mansion for an English cottage.

e.fact: José Feliciano recorded it in 1970 – in both Spanish and English.
Chris Rea came up with it while stuck in traffic on his way home for Christmas.
Brenda Lee was 13 when she recorded it in 1958 – and 65 years later it hit number one in the US.
Band Aid recorded it in 1984 to raise money for famine relief in Ethiopia.
The Pogues and Kirsty MacColl, 1987 – it never actually reached number one in the UK.
Shakin' Stevens' song was the UK number one at Christmas 1985.

f.fact: "Run, run, as fast as you can!" Queen Elizabeth I is said to have served gingerbread figures of her guests.
Every family member stirs it on "Stir-up Sunday" – then it is served flaming with brandy.
George Washington had his own (very boozy) eggnog recipe.
It's shaped like a shepherd's crook – the red stripes arrived around 1900.
The French bûche de Noël is a cake shaped like the log once burned in the hearth.
Mince pies once contained real minced meat – today they are filled with dried fruit and spice.

g.answer: I Saw Mommy Kissing Santa Claus
wrong: Santa Claus Is Coming to Town
g.fact: The original was recorded in 1952 by Jimmy Boyd – who was just 13.
Santa ends up in court and has to prove he's real. The 1947 original won three Oscars.
A lazy postman and a reclusive toymaker invent Santa – Netflix's 2019 hit was Oscar-nominated.
Michael Caine plays Scrooge, and Kermit is his long-suffering clerk Bob Cratchit.
Pa-rum-pum-pum-pum! It was first called "Carol of the Drum" when it was written in 1941.

wrong: All I Want for Christmas Is You
g.fact: Eartha Kitt’s 1953 wish list includes a sable, a convertible – and a yacht.

iceSlide.title: Frozen Lake
iceSlide.instruction: The penguin slides until it bumps into a rock or the shore – and stops in snowdrifts. Guide it to the present!
iceSlide.stuck: Oops! The penguin can never reach the present from here.
iceSlide.keys: Arrow keys / WASD · Z to undo

nonogram.title: Christmas Picross
nonogram.instruction: The numbers tell how many squares in a row are filled in each row and column. Paint the secret picture!
nonogram.tip: Drag to paint several squares · long-press or right-click for X
nonogram.mistakes: {{count}} square(s) are wrong – they flash red
nonogram.revealed: One square was filled in for you ✨

lightPath.title: Light the Village
lightPath.instruction: Tap a tile to turn its string lights. Run the power from the cosy cabin to every house and tree!

giftMatch.title: Gift Match
giftMatch.instruction: Swap neighbouring pieces to line up three or more. Reach {{target}} points before you run out of moves!
giftMatch.lostText: You got {{score}} of {{target}} points. So close – have another go!
giftMatch.boardLabel: Game board. Use the arrow keys to move and Enter to pick and swap pieces.
giftMatch.legend: Match 4 for a striped piece that clears a line · match 5 for a star that clears every piece of one kind
giftMatch.instructionEndless: Festive time attack! Score as much as you can in {{seconds}} seconds – big combos and special pieces add extra time. The clock starts with your first swap.

treeLights.title: Light Up the Tree
treeLights.instruction: Tapping a bulb flips it and its neighbours. Light every bulb to make the star shine!

jingleBells.title: Bell Choir
jingleBells.instruction: Listen and repeat the bells in order. Start with one note; each successful round adds one more from We Wish You a Merry Christmas. Reach {{target}} notes to win — matching the rhythm is optional.
jingleBells.win: Beautiful! Enjoy the rest of the carol…
jingleBells.soundTip: Best with sound on – but you can also follow the glowing bells.
jingleBells.endlessInstruction: Endless mode: how long a melody can you remember? One wrong bell ends the run.
jingleBells.gameOver: The choir rests! You remembered {{score}} notes.

snowballToss.title: Snowball Fight
snowballToss.instruction: Drag back from the snowball and let go to throw. Knock down every snowman!
snowballToss.canvasLabel: Backyard with snowmen. Drag back to aim and release to throw.
snowballToss.how1: Drag back from the snowball like a slingshot – the dots show where it will fly.
snowballToss.how2: Check the windsock: the wind nudges every throw.
snowballToss.how3: Knock down all {{snowmen}} snowmen with {{balls}} snowballs.
snowballToss.keyboard: Keyboard: arrow keys aim, space throws.
snowballToss.loseText: {{left}} snowmen are still standing. Scoop up more snow and try again!
snowballToss.howEndless: Endless snowball fight! Clear wave after wave – every cleared wave refills your snowballs. How far can you get?
snowballToss.endlessText: You made it to wave {{wave}}. Your score:

chimneyDrop.title: Present Drop
chimneyDrop.instruction: Tap to drop presents from the sleigh – land them in the chimneys!
chimneyDrop.canvasLabel: Santa's sleigh flying over a snowy town. Tap or press space to drop a present.
chimneyDrop.how1: Tap, click or press space to drop a present.
chimneyDrop.how2: Presents keep the sleigh's speed – let go a little before the chimney.
chimneyDrop.how3: Deliver {{target}} presents. You have {{presents}} in the sack.
chimneyDrop.howWind: Watch out – the wind sways back and forth and pushes the presents.
chimneyDrop.win: Ho ho ho! Every present delivered!
chimneyDrop.loseText: You delivered {{delivered}} of {{target}} presents. Santa refills the sack – try again!
chimneyDrop.howEndless: Endless night! The sleigh slowly speeds up. Three presents in the snow and the night is over.

snowmanStack.title: Build a Snowman
snowmanStack.instruction: Tap (or press space) to drop the swinging snowball. Stack {{count}} balls nice and straight!
snowmanStack.endlessInstruction: Endless snow tower! Stack as high as you can – three tumbles and it's over.
snowmanStack.keyHint: Space or Enter drops the ball
snowmanStack.lostText: You stacked {{count}} snowballs. Pack some fresh snow and try again!

tomteWhack.title: Whack-a-Tomte
tomteWhack.instruction: Bonk the cheeky tomtar as they pop up – reach {{target}} points before the candle burns down!
tomteWhack.endlessInstruction: Survival mode! Don't let a tomte slip away and leave the coal and goat alone – three slips and it's over.
tomteWhack.legend: Tap tomtar (golden ones are worth extra). Leave the coal and the Christmas goat alone!
tomteWhack.endlessLegend: Missing a tomte or tapping coal or the goat costs a heart. It gets faster and faster!
tomteWhack.overText: You got {{score}} of {{target}} points. The tomtar are hiding again – one more go?
tomteWhack.win: The tomtar give up – you win!

spotDifference.title: Spot the Difference
spotDifference.instruction: The right picture hides {{count}} differences. Tap them on either picture!
spotDifference.win: Eagle eyes! You found them all!

toySorter.title: Elf Workshop
toySorter.instruction: Send every item into the right sack before it tumbles off the belt. Swipe, tap a side or use ← →.
toySorter.ready: The belt is ready – are you, elf?
toySorter.lost: Three mix-ups – the elves are giggling! Ready for another shift?

funFacts.title: Fun Fact!
funFacts.day2: Jambiz Group was founded in 2010 by two entrepreneurs who wanted to give small businesses access to the same services as large corporations.
funFacts.day3: Jambiz Group has offices in Malmö (Gustav Adolfs torg 51) and Göteborg/Kungsbacka (Magasinsgatan 8c).
funFacts.day4: XBUS (Excellent Business Services) works by three core values: competence, hard work, and having fun!
funFacts.day6: ProgressLEAD specializes in strategy, transformation, project, program and portfolio management.
funFacts.day7: Did you know there is a theater production company in Jamaica also called Jambiz? Talk about a name with international appeal!
funFacts.day8: Exceed Consulting focuses on making a positive difference by helping organizations with quality, sustainability, and business development.
funFacts.day9: SwCG (Swedish Consulting Group) serves as a meeting place for the entire IT industry, connecting clients with the best consultants.
funFacts.day10: Podium System is home to experts in travel and transport, planning and optimization – delivering tailored cloud-based solutions.
funFacts.day11: AnalyticLEAD offers deep expertise in information management, advanced analytics, data science and data governance.
funFacts.day12: LearningLEAD offers coaching, mentorship, courses and workshops within Project Management, Facilitation, and Lean-Agile Transformation (SAFe®).
funFacts.day13: Addends offers facilitation services using LEGO® Serious Play® methodology – believing business can be done better through playfulness!
funFacts.day14: Sprinta created CertumHub – an AI-powered platform for e-learning, compliance management, and sustainability certifications with 50+ course categories!
funFacts.day15: The name 'Jambiz' was created by combining the initials of the founders' names: Jorgen And Mikael's Business = JAMBIZ!
funFacts.day16: Jambiz provides security, development, and growth for member companies through collaboration and economies of scale.
funFacts.day17: XBUS offers support services including HR, Recruitment, Finance, Marketing & Communication, and Office Support – all under one roof!
funFacts.day18: Jambiz Group's vision: "The future of business lies in bringing together people and companies who want to develop themselves and the market."
funFacts.day20: Podium System's cloud platform delivers tailored solutions for customers in public sector, logistics, tourism and transport.
funFacts.day21: LearningLEAD instructors are SAFe® Program Consultants, PMP® certified, and LEGO® Serious Play® certified facilitators.
funFacts.day22: The Jambiz Development Center is formed by developers from both Sprinta and Podium System working together on innovative solutions.
funFacts.day23: Jambiz owns an apartment called 'Casa Progresso' in sunny Almuñecar, Spain! Employees can book it at a special price for their vacation getaways. ☀️🏖️

info.title: How the Calendar Works

welcome.title: 🎄 Welcome to the Advent Calendar!
welcome.content: Hey there! This is our Jambiz Advent Calendar – 24 mini-challenges to brighten up your December. Whether you're here for a quick brain teaser or just want to learn something fun about Jambiz, we've got you covered!

unlocking.title: 🔓 How Days Unlock
unlocking.content: Just like a real advent calendar, each day unlocks on its date in December. So day 1 opens on December 1st, day 5 opens on December 5th, and so on. You'll see a lock icon on days that aren't available yet – but don't worry, they'll be ready when the time comes!

challenges.title: 🎮 The Games
challenges.content: Behind every door waits one of 14 brand-new Christmas games: Juldle, emoji carols, a frozen lake to slide across, Christmas picross, whack-a-tomte, a snowball fight, Santa's present drop and more. They take a few minutes each and you can always retry – the goal is cosy fun, not perfection.

rewards.title: 🏆 Completing Challenges
rewards.content: When you complete a challenge, you unlock a reward – it could be a fun fact, a video, an image, or something else! Plus, each completed day reveals a piece of the big picture puzzle that the calendar forms. Complete all 24 days to see the full masterpiece! Your progress is saved automatically, so you can close the browser and come back anytime.

replay.title: 🔄 Want to Play Again?
replay.content: Replay any completed day by clicking its revealed picture, or choose Play Again in the game window. Each new run can improve your daily best and global total. Slower runs never reduce your best score, and completed days stay completed.

christmas.title: 🎅 The Big Day - December 25th
christmas.content: Here's the best part: on Christmas Day (December 25th), EVERYTHING unlocks for everyone! So if you missed a few days or life got busy, don't sweat it. You'll be able to play all the challenges and see all the rewards anyway.

extras.title: 🎁 Extras & Rewards Gallery
extras.content: Finish all 24 doors (or just wait until Christmas Day) to unlock the Extras: bonus levels for every game, from easy to expert, plus endless modes where you chase your own high score. The gallery collects every reward in one place.

tip.title: 💡 Pro Tip
tip.content: Your progress is saved in your browser's local storage, so we recommend using the same device and browser throughout December to keep your progress. If you switch devices, you'll start fresh on the new one – but remember, everything unlocks on Christmas anyway!

info.closing: Have fun, and happy holidays from the Jambiz team! 🎄✨
